children.name: Check
children.value: not verified: a channel element's end needs its spectral data

findings.message: ADTS cannot signal SBR or PS explicitly. They can be signaled implicitly, in the fill elements of the access units, which are not checked yet; the stream may be HE-AAC or HE-AAC v2.
The CRC of 1 ADTS frame, first at 0x1AC, covers a channel element whose end is not known without its spectral data, which is not parsed yet, so it is not verified.
